mapper.sql: r.id AS id, r.requester_user_id AS requester_user_id, r.asset_id AS asset_id, linked_asset.code AS asset_code, linked_asset.name AS asset_name, linked_asset.is_deleted AS asset_deleted, requester.name AS requester_name, r.process_type_code AS process_type_code, process_type.name AS process_type_name, r.status_code AS status_code, request_status.name AS status_name, r.title AS title, r.content AS content, r.review_comment AS review_comment, r.submitted_at AS submitted_at, r.created_at AS created_at, r.updated_at AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, requester.name AS requester_name, r.asset_id AS asset_id, linked_asset.code AS asset_code, linked_asset.name AS asset_name, linked_asset.is_deleted AS asset_deleted, r.process_type_code AS process_type_code, process_type.name AS process_type_name, r.status_code AS status_code, request_status.name AS status_name, r.title AS title, r.submitted_at AS submitted_at, r.created_at AS created_at, r.updated_at AS updated_at FROM requests r INNER JOIN users requester ON requester.id = r.requester_user_id AND requester.company_id = r.company_id AND requester.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN assets linked_asset ON linked_asset.id = r.asset_id AND linked_asset.company_id = r.company_id INNER JOIN common_master process_type_master ON process_type_master.code = 'PROCESS_TYPE' AND process_type_master.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN common_master_values process_type ON process_type.common_master_id = process_type_master.id AND process_type.code = r.process_type_code AND process_type.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN common_master request_status_master ON request_status_master.code = 'REQUEST_STATUS' AND request_status_master.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN common_master_values request_status ON request_status.common_master_id = request_status_master.id AND request_status.code = r.status_code AND request_status.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT
FROM requests r INNER JOIN users requester ON requester.id = r.requester_user_id AND requester.company_id = r.company_id AND requester.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN assets linked_asset ON linked_asset.id = r.asset_id AND linked_asset.company_id = r.company_id INNER JOIN common_master process_type_master ON process_type_master.code = 'PROCESS_TYPE' AND process_type_master.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN common_master_values process_type ON process_type.common_master_id = process_type_master.id AND process_type.code = r.process_type_code AND process_type.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN common_master request_status_master ON request_status_master.code = 'REQUEST_STATUS' AND request_status_master.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN common_master_values request_status ON request_status.common_master_id = request_status_master.id AND request_status.code = r.status_code AND request_status.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT process_type.code AS code, process_type.name AS name FROM common_master process_type_master INNER JOIN common_master_values process_type ON process_type.common_master_id = process_type_master.id AND process_type.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE process_type_master.code = 'PROCESS_TYPE' AND process_type_master.is_deleted = FALSE AND process_type.code IN ('PURCHASE', 'REPAIR', 'DISPOSAL') ORDER BY process_type.sort_order ASC, process_type.id ASC
SELECT a.id AS id, a.code AS code, a.name AS name FROM assets a WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY a.code ASC, a.id ASC

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM common_master process_type_master INNER JOIN common_master_values process_type ON process_type.common_master_id = process_type_master.id AND process_type.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE process_type_master.code = 'PROCESS_TYPE' AND process_type_master.is_deleted = FALSE AND process_type.code = #{processTypeCode} AND process_type.code IN ('PURCHASE', 'REPAIR', 'DISPOSAL') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requests ( company_id, requester_user_id, asset_id, process_type_code, status_code, title, content, review_comment, submitted_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{requesterUserId}, #{assetId}, #{processTypeCode}, 'DRAFT', #{title}, #{content}, NULL, NULL, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
